metadata.policy: deterministic reactive oracle; zero model calls
metadata.result_scope: 24-task scripted fixture gate; not the 864-episode model main

main_study_contract.primary_hypothesis: R2 improves recoverable-fault SafePass^3 over R1 while preserving clean SafeSuccess within a five-percentage-point noninferiority margin and without adding severe side effects.

limitations: This is a deterministic oracle fixture gate, not an LLM-agent result.
The expanded tasks use one environment seed and require model-stage task-card review.
The second exact model binding is absent, so the 864-episode main remains blocked.
Bootstrap confidence intervals and mechanism ablations are separate pending gates.
